artworks.title: Studies for Joan of Arc
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on wove paper
artworks.description: The image features fluid and swirling lines that form abstract figures in various poses. The lines suggest human figures standing or sitting closely together, with loosely defined limbs and bodies. The drawing evokes a scene of figures in conversation or deep in thought, reminiscent of a busy café or a casual group gathering. The delicate and sketchy style enhances the sense of motion and life captured on the canvas.

artworks.title: Figure Studies (recto)
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a series of abstract figures in various poses. The composition consists of multiple humanoid forms scattered across the paper, depicted in different dynamic positions. The figures are outlined with simple lines and gestures, suggesting movement and fluidity. The drawing has an exploratory and sketch-like quality, indicating a study or practice in capturing body positions and form. The figures are arranged without a clear focal point, creating a sense of randomness and spontaneity. The use of a limited color palette, primarily brown ink on light paper, emphasizes the linearity and raw nature of the sketches.

artworks.title: Architectural Study
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray and brown wash over graphite on laid paper, with the cupola redrawn on a separate piece of paper and pasted down
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a neoclassical building facade with columns and a clock tower. The drawing presents a symmetrical architectural design with detailed elements. The central part of the building features a prominent entrance flanked by four large columns in the Corinthian order, which support an entablature adorned with classic friezes. Above the entablature rests a clock tower with a dome. The lower portions include arched openings and niches containing sculptures or reliefs. The left side of the drawing shows additional segmentations, suggesting window placements, while the right side is faded. The meticulous linework and use of shadows enhance the depth and dimensionality, emphasizing the structure's grandeur and classical inspiration.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Bridge
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown-gray wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a rural landscape with a bridge crossing a stream. Figures, including one with a horse, are on and near the bridge. Two buildings are visible in the distance surrounded by hills and trees. The brushstrokes are delicate and sketch-like, with a limited sepia and grey color palette. Trees flank the composition, adding depth.

artworks.title: Landscape with Shepherds
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk, heightened with white gouache (oxidized), on laid paper, laid down on old mount
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is set high with distant hills and small structures visible. In the foreground, there are people and animals gathered beneath trees. The trees have lush canopies and intertwined branches. The artwork is created with light, fluid brushstrokes. The color palette is subdued, with sepia tones dominating and gentle variations in browns and grays.

artworks.title: Rebecca at the Well
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing displaying two figures near a well. One figure is leaning on the edge of the well while the other is standing beside them in a thoughtful pose. The lines are clean and precise, detailing the clothing and hair. On the left are abstract lines hinting at foliage, adding a natural element to the scene. The simplicity of the lines highlights the interaction between the two figures in the tranquil setting.

artworks.title: A Battle on Horseback
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene with horses and warriors. The image is filled with figures in motion, illustrating the intensity of the skirmish. Horses are shown galloping and rearing, while warriors engage in combat with shields and weapons. The detailed linework conveys movement and drama, with overlapping forms emphasizing the complexity of the battle. Fine lines and cross-hatching add depth and texture to capture the energy and chaos of the scene.

artworks.title: Venetian Capriccio with Boats Unloading (recto); Figures among Ruins (verso)
artworks.medium:
pen and brown ink over black chalk with gray-brown wash on laid paper (recto)
black chalk, pen and two colors of brown ink, grey-brown wash on laid paper (verso)
artworks.description: The image shows a harbor or waterfront setting with architectural elements in the foreground. Faded figures and animals are seen along a pathway with stone arches and columns. In the background, figures are engaged around boats and ships in the water. Distant buildings, including a dome and spires, are visible on the horizon. The artwork features delicate brushstrokes, an impressionistic style, and a subdued color palette of earthy tones, gray, and brown.

artworks.title: Esther before Ahasuerus
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures gathered around a throne in an opulent setting. The drawing depicts an ornately decorated interior space with classical architectural elements. At the center, there is a figure seated on a throne elevated above the rest, adorned with a crown. Surrounding this central figure are numerous other figures engaged in what seems to be a formal or ceremonial gathering. The figures are dressed in flowing garments and are positioned in dynamic, animated poses. The shading and line work add depth, creating a sense of drama and narrative within the scene.

artworks.title: A Standing Man Leaning on a Stick
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash, laid down on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body sketch of a person standing in profile. The individual is facing to the right, with one leg slightly bent. The face is depicted in profile with minimal detail, and the hair appears covered by a head wrap or turban. The person is dressed in a long robe with a sash tied at the waist and loose-fitting trousers tucked into high boots or wrappings. The person is holding a long stick or staff in one hand and the other hand is raised with fingers pointed. The background is plain and unadorned, highlighting the detailed lines of the figure.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Washerwoman
artworks.medium: graphite with stumping on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Helen Porter and James T. Dyke in honor of Andrew Robison
artworks.description: The image shows a view from a slightly elevated position looking down at a wooded area, filled with trees. The horizon is obscured by dense foliage and trees, which dominate the scene. The brushstroke technique includes fine, detailed lines and shading, creating a textured effect on the foliage and trees. The color palette is monochromatic, with blacks, whites, and grays accentuating forms and textures. Closest to us, leafy vegetation is densely packed, with a figure bending towards a narrow stream. In the distance, there is a partially visible structure resembling a fence or wall, blending into the natural surroundings.

artworks.title: Landscape with Penitent Saints
artworks.artist: Veronese 16th Century (possibly Battista Angolo del Moro)
artworks.description: The image shows a natural landscape with a cave on the right side. The viewpoint is at eye level, capturing the mountains meeting the sky at the horizon. A figure is kneeling at the entrance of the cave, surrounded by trees with detailed foliage and textures. The artist uses intricate lines to show depth and texture, resembling etching or engraving. The color palette is monochromatic, using grays and blacks to emphasize details and contrasts. In the distance, there are mountains and structures resembling a settlement. Nearer to the viewer, a path leads to two figures and a donkey, bordered by trees and rocks.

artworks.title: Narcissus
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a low horizon featuring high mountainous peaks on the left. The terrain close by includes trees, rocks, and rocky formations on the right, leading to a range of hills and valleys in the distance. The artwork has detailed strokes creating texture and depth, particularly in the trees, rocks, and swirling clouds in the sky. The color palette is monochromatic, focusing on black and gray shades to enhance the sense of depth and intricacy.

artworks.title: The Penitent Magdalene
artworks.artist: Willem van Swanenburgh, after Abraham Bloemaert
artworks.description: The image shows a woman sitting and leaning on her right arm, with her gaze directed upwards. She has long, flowing hair, wearing a loose garment and holding a jar. A small cross is to her right, and in front of her on the ground is a human skull surrounded by flowers. The background features a rocky landscape with tree branches, and a cloudy sky with an ethereal figure amidst the clouds.

artworks.title: Saint Roch Distributing Alms
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 28.8 × 45.7 cm (11 5/16 × 18 in.), trimmed to platemark
artworks.description: This is a drawing of draped figures in a grand architectural setting. The scene depicts a gathering with columns and arches in the background. The figures are engaged in various activities. Some appear to offer or receive something while others observe or gesture. There is a dynamic energy in the arrangement of the figures. The overall tone of the drawing is intricate and detailed, with fine lines outlining the forms and expressions of each character. The architectural elements add depth and a sense of place to the scene.

artworks.title: The Obsequies of Agostino Carracci: First Plate
artworks.artist: Guido Reni, after Francesco Brizio, Giacomo Cavedone, Agostino Carracci, and Alessandro Albino
artworks.description: The image shows a collection of five small rectangular illustrations arranged in a grid pattern. The top-left illustration features two figures seated among foliage; one reclined while the other stands. The central image is a detailed portrait of a man's face with long wavy hair and a beard. The top-right illustration shows two figures, one gesturing or holding a raised object, with a cloud beneath them. The bottom-left image depicts a standing figure pointing upward next to a floating figure draped in cloth surrounded by stars. The bottom-right illustration shows two figures engaged in motion surrounded by swirling lines suggestive of wind or clouds. The background is a plain, lightly textured surface with handwritten notes at the bottom, including numerical figures and possible signature or cataloging information.

artworks.title: The Obsequies of Agostino Carracci: Second Plate
artworks.artist: Guido Reni, after Ippolito Ferrantino, G. B. Bertusi, Sebastiano Rozali, Lucio Massai, and G. B. Busi
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting five panels of mythological and celestial scenes. The first panel shows a figure with wings holding a staff. The second panel features a haloed figure among others. The third panel shows a winged figure interacting with others. In the fourth panel, a reclining figure is depicted with rays of light. The fifth panel shows figures in an airborne scene among clouds.

artworks.title: The Obsequies of  Agostino Carracci: Third Plate
artworks.artist: Guido Reni, after Giulio Cesare Parigino, after Lorenzo Garbieri, Giovanni Luigi Valesio, Aurelio Bonelli, Lodovico Carracci, and Lorenzo Garbieri
artworks.description:
This drawing shows five distinct scenes contained within defined spaces. Each scene is framed by thin lines.  

The first vignette shows figures in flowing garments against a backdrop of swirling clouds. Below, a reclining figure is surrounded by a celestial atmosphere. 

The central vignette features a seated figure looking towards standing figures. The fourth scene shows reclining figures engaging in repose or discourse, with one figure extending a hand. 

The last vignette depicts a figure in motion, conveying energy and determination through garment folds and pose. Each scene is detailed with attention to garment folds and figure expressions, emphasizing drama and emotion.

artworks.title: Christ and the Samaritan Woman
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 28.8 × 41.1 cm (11 5/16 × 16 3/16 in.); trimmed within platemark
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a group scene with various individuals around a well in an outdoor setting. The artwork shows a central composition with a well, around which several figures are gathered. The drawing is detailed, with intricate linework highlighting the folds in the figures' clothing. The background includes trees, a building, and hills, adding depth to the scene. The figures are engaged in various activities, such as discussion or contemplation. The drawing suggests a narrative or dialogue, but lacks facial expressions or explicit context for interpretation.

artworks.title: Virgin and Child in Glory
artworks.description: The image shows a seated woman holding a small child on her lap. The woman is positioned slightly turned to the side, with her head inclined downward, gazing at the child. She has a serene expression and gentle demeanor. Her hair is styled simply and partially covered. The child is resting against her chest, with one arm around her neck and legs extended. The woman wears flowing draped robes, with cherubic figures with wings near her. The background features clouds and subtle rays behind the woman's head, giving a sense of divinity.

artworks.title: Guardian Angel
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in an outdoor setting. One figure is an angel with large wings and flowing garments, walking to the left. The other figure is a child barefoot and holding the angel's hand. The background features a rocky landscape and a dynamic sky with swirling clouds. The drawing is monochrome with detailed line work.

artworks.title: Venus and Adonis
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 11.6 × 17.1 cm (4 9/16 × 6 3/4 in.), trimmed within platemark
artworks.description: The image shows three figures in a natural setting. Two adult figures are seated on a rocky or earthy outcrop. One figure has their back to the viewer, embracing the other figure who is seated facing forward. Both have prominent facial features and detailed hairstyles. A smaller figure resembling a cherub with wings and holding a staff or arrow is positioned near the seated figures. All three figures are unclothed. The scene is surrounded by trees with detailed foliage, and a small sleeping dog is shown in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Saint  Anthony of Padua Holding the Christ Child
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of an adult and a child. The adult is standing while holding the child in his arms, showing support and affection. The facial features of both individuals are delicately drawn. The adult is wearing a flowing garment and is surrounded by fabric folds. In the background, there are architectural elements like a railing or balustrade, and there are floral elements on the ground.

artworks.title: Saint Sebastian
artworks.description: The image shows a seated, nude male figure leaning against a tree with his entire body visible. His left arm rests on his forehead, and his legs are extended forward. The figure has wavy hair, which frames his face, and his facial features suggest a contemplative or resting expression. A small, winged figure is shown hovering above him with one arm stretched forward. An arrow is depicted piercing the seated man's side. The surroundings include lightly sketched foliage and a tree trunk behind the man, contributing to a natural setting. The background features clouds. The image appears to be a detailed engraving or drawing, with text and numbers written in the margins of the sheet.
